note: Sunflower-yellow alphabet classroom A–M (cartoon style): letters A to H as sound figures in reading order, back row left to right A B C D, front row E F G H. Landmark: the giant tower of blank toy blocks in the back right corner (zoom: the block corner holds I to M). The open yellow door on the left goes back out to the school yard; the mint door on the right leads to the alphabet room N–Z. Letters have no gender (divider null).
